title: Interactive Single-Cell Simulation Benchmarking with scSimEvalStudio
text: scSimEvalStudio provides interactive Shiny graphical studio companion scSimEval. scSimEval focuses cleanly Bioconductor programmatic evaluation across SingleCellExperiment objects reproducibility pipelines, scSimEvalStudio exposes point--click dataset uploads, real-time evaluation progress logs, pre-saved .rds exploration, interactive zoomable plots, Excel/figure exports.

title: Interactive Single-Cell Simulation Benchmarking with scSimEvalStudio
text: installing scSimEval scSimEvalStudio, launch interactive studio R: default, launch_scSimEval_app() configures shiny.maxRequestSize 10 GiB (10 * 1024^3) large multiomics .rds archives can loaded locally.

title: Launch Interactive scSimEval Benchmarking Studio — launch_scSimEval_app
text: Launches companion Shiny web application bundled scSimEvalStudio. Provides graphical interface upload SingleCellExperiment biological reference simulated datasets (scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, paired unpaired multiomics), inspect 56 evaluation metrics, explore diagnostic figures interactively, export high-resolution plots Excel/PDF reports.

title: Launch Interactive scSimEval Benchmarking Studio — launch_scSimEval_app
code: launch_scSimEval_app(   port = NULL,   host = "127.0.0.1",   launch.browser = interactive(),   maxRequestSize = 10 * 1024^3 )

title: Launch Interactive scSimEval Benchmarking Studio — launch_scSimEval_app
text: port Optional port number local web server. Default NULL (random open port). host Character string specifying IP address listen . Defaults "127.0.0.1". launch.browser Logical, whether automatically open default web browser. Defaults interactive(). maxRequestSize Numeric maximum upload file size bytes. Defaults 10 * 1024^3 (10 GiB).

title: Launch Interactive scSimEval Benchmarking Studio — launch_scSimEval_app
